tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Anthropic has pitched a bill focused on artificial intelligence safety that could block a model if 50 or more people could be killed, reported by TechCrunch.
DeepSeek makes DeepInfer open source to cut artificial intelligence costs and boost market leadership, reported by TechTarget.
The Trump administration has lost its bid to block a lawsuit from the NAACP against Musk's xAI over a data center, reported by Reuters.
Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini artificial intelligence assistant to your car using connected app data, confirmed by TechCrunch.
TTEC Digital has unveiled 40 or more artificial intelligence agents on Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise to help modernize government experiences, reported by Markets Insider.
Free every hour.
